prerequisites.notes: Compilation passes. No checkstyle plugin configured. Spec and Flyway migrations (V6, V7, V8) verified. 2 pre-existing test failures (LocationServiceTest, LocalStorageProviderTest) exist on main — not introduced by this branch.

findings.message: NPE when lastEx is null after InterruptedException breaks out of retry loop before any attempt catches an exception
SUM aggregate returns null when no rows exist; partnerTotal and userTotal would NPE on subtract
@Lazy @Autowired field injection on self violates constructor-injection-only convention
findings.manualAction: Extract REQUIRES_NEW methods into a delegate bean or use ApplicationContextAware pattern

findings.message: Two @Entity classes (RewardBalance, RewardWallet) mapped to the same table 'reward_wallets' — risk of cache conflicts and accidental writes
findings.manualAction: Remove @Entity/@Table from deprecated RewardBalance; use plain POJO adapter only

findings.message: DataIntegrityViolationException caught in retry loop masks genuine constraint violations — FIXED: isUniqueViolation() helper now narrows retry to SQLState 23505 only
findWallet() uses non-locking findById() in mutation paths; @Version + retry handles correctness but pessimistic lock would avoid wasted retries
Ledger idempotency — FIXED: V7 adds uq_ledger_credit_idempotency partial unique index on (reward_wallet_id, reference_type, reference_id) WHERE entry_type='CREDIT'

getUserWallets() applies clientId tenant isolation but does no explicit ownership/existence check on the target user. Cross-tenant access is prevented but a valid-tenant userId with no wallets returns 404 (prevents enumeration, but no explicit user lookup).
findings.manualAction: Consider adding explicit user-in-tenant lookup before wallet query to prevent information leakage in edge cases

findings.message: hasRole() prefers SecurityContextHolder over CustomUserDetails parameter; in async contexts, SecurityContextHolder may hold wrong principal
findings.manualAction: Use user.getAuthorities() exclusively; remove SecurityContextHolder dual-source

findings.message: AccessDeniedException throws not logged — financial access denials should be recorded for audit
findings.manualAction: Add structured log.warn() before each AccessDeniedException throw with caller userId and requested resource

contract-compliance.notes: All 3 endpoints match contract exactly: GET /api/v1/wallets/me, GET /api/v1/wallets/company/{companyId}, GET /api/v1/wallets/users/{userId}. HTTP methods, path parameters, status codes (200/401/403/404), and RewardWalletResponse schema all align with contracts/endpoints/wallet.yaml.

findings.summary: grantReward @Transactional(REQUIRED) + walletService.credit() REQUIRES_NEW atomicity gap — RESOLVED: grantReward now calls walletService.creditInCurrentTx() which is @Transactional(REQUIRED) and joins the outer transaction. RewardTransaction, BudgetUtilization, and wallet credit all commit atomically in the same tx.
findings.tierReason: alreadyHandled=true — creditInCurrentTx(@Transactional(REQUIRED)) added to WalletService; grantReward now calls it instead of credit(). Atomicity gap is closed.
findings.recommendation: Already fixed in working tree. Commit changes.

findings.summary: DataIntegrityViolationException catch too broad in withOptimisticRetry — retried FK/NOT NULL failures indefinitely
findings.tierReason: alreadyHandled=true — isUniqueViolation() helper added in working tree, narrows to SQLState 23505; non-unique violations are immediately re-thrown
findings.recommendation: Already fixed in working tree. Commit changes.

findings.summary: applyBudgetCap first-call upsert race — concurrent INSERTs both find no row, both attempt INSERT, loser gets uncaught DataIntegrityViolationException
findings.tierReason: alreadyHandled=true — ensureExists() uses INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING backed by V9 unique indexes (uq_budget_util_global, uq_budget_util_location); race is eliminated at DB level
findings.recommendation: Already fixed in working tree. Commit changes.

findings.summary: @Modifying ensureExists() missing clearAutomatically=true — if BudgetUtilization was previously loaded in same Hibernate session, first-level cache may return stale entity for the subsequent findByIncentiveIdAndCurrencyId...ForUpdate call
findings.tierReason: severity=medium — advisory regardless of confidence. confidence=0.60 (<0.70); @Lock PESSIMISTIC_WRITE typically forces a DB round-trip in Hibernate so risk may not materialise.
findings.recommendation: Add clearAutomatically=true to the @Modifying annotation on ensureExists() to guarantee the first-level cache is evicted after the INSERT, ensuring the subsequent locking query always reads fresh data.

findings.summary: findWallet() uses non-locking findById() in mutation paths — @Version + retry provides correctness but wastes retry cycles on contended wallets
findings.tierReason: confidence=0.55 (<0.70) — @Version optimistic locking + retry provides correctness; pessimistic lock is a performance optimization, not a correctness fix
findings.recommendation: Add findByIdForUpdate(@Lock PESSIMISTIC_WRITE) to RewardWalletRepository for use in reserve/debit/release/returnCredit mutation paths.

findings.summary: @Lazy @Autowired self field — non-final mutable field violates constructor-injection convention
findings.tierReason: confidence=0.45 (<0.70) — standard Spring self-proxy pattern; production-safe in singleton scope. Violates project convention but not a runtime risk.
findings.recommendation: Use ApplicationContextAware or extract REQUIRES_NEW methods to a delegate bean to eliminate the self-reference.

findings.summary: NPE on lastEx==null in withOptimisticRetry after InterruptedException breaks loop before any attempt catches an exception
findings.tierReason: alreadyHandled=true — null guard added in working tree (throws IllegalStateException when lastEx is null)
findings.recommendation: Already fixed in working tree. Commit changes.

findings.summary: SUM aggregate returns null when no rows exist — partnerTotal/userTotal NPE on subtract
findings.tierReason: alreadyHandled=true — wrapped with Optional.ofNullable(...).orElse(BigDecimal.ZERO) in working tree
findings.recommendation: Already fixed in working tree. Commit changes.

classificationRules.advisoryThreshold: severity medium/low OR confidence < 0.70 OR alreadyHandled=true
